scenario: 1 bp Tolerance Gate Calculation Evaluated Against 1,000-Row Sample Instead of Full Dataset
steps:
1. In View 1, enter official 1M manifest control totals (Gross = ,643,595,200.00, Net = ,842,500,000.00)
2. Observe the calculated variance percentage and status badge in View 1
expected: UI compares entered control totals against the true full dataset totals or clarifies that verification compares against sample preview before triggering full Pass 2 reconciliation.
actual: DEFECT FOUND (DEF-UI-07): UI compares the entered .6B GL totals against the 1,000-row sample (.1M), computing an erroneous 99.9% variance and prematurely locking user into Quarantine mode before full file scan executes.
dev_comments: DEF-UI-07: In View1Reconcile.jsx, calculate control variance against total_gross/total_net returned from Pass 2 reconciliation metadata rather than sample preview sums.

scenario: Quarantine Protocol Mandatory Acknowledgement & Indelible Watermark Display
preconditions: Discrepancy > 1 bp between entered numbers and scanned data
steps:
1. Enter mismatched control totals
2. Verify Quarantine button disabled
3. Check acknowledgement checkbox
4. Click Quarantine button
5. Inspect watermark banner across views
expected: Quarantine button remains disabled until explicit user acknowledgement checkbox is ticked; upon submission, permanent watermark displays UNRECONCILED RESIDUAL: X.XX% () OUTSIDE AUDIT GUARDRAILS.
actual: Mandatory acknowledgement checkbox strictly guards Quarantine button; upon submission, prominent rose-colored banner displays UNRECONCILED RESIDUAL: 99.99% (,609,042,102.86) OUTSIDE AUDIT GUARDRAILS across the application.
dev_comments: Quarantine protocol workflow and indelible watermark banner adhere strictly to R2.4 and AC-8.

scenario: Three-Column Attribute Categorization for 62 Categorical Attributes in View 2
preconditions: Ingest 87-column stress dataset and navigate to Step 2 (2. Compare Similar Deals)
steps:
1. Navigate to Step 2
2. Inspect 1. FAIR PRICING FACTORS, 2. AUDITED DEAL FACTORS, and 3. EXCLUDED ATTRIBUTES
3. Verify presence of 62 categorical attributes as selectable chips
expected: All 62 categorical columns (sales theater, product family, customer tier, SLA level, etc.) appear as interactive attribute chips allowing users to assign comparability controls.
actual: DEFECT FOUND (DEF-UI-08): All 3 attribute categorization boxes display 0 factors and No attributes loaded yet. Upload data in Step 1 to populate available columns. Schema columns are not forwarded from View 1 to View 2, blocking comparability assignment.
dev_comments: DEF-UI-08: In App.jsx, pass active dataset schema / column list as props to <View2Calibrate />, or fetch /api/workspace column manifest upon mounting.

scenario: Boundary Threshold Selection & Capture Haircut Slider Responsiveness
steps:

2. Adjust Realistic Target Recovery slider

expected: Threshold toggle buttons switch active selection cleanly; slider adjusts recovery haircut kappa between 0.10 and 1.00 (default 0.40); Save Pricing Baseline & Lock Deals is clickable.

scenario: Deep Culprit Traversal on High-Dimensional Stress Dataset
preconditions: Navigate to View 3 (3. Discover Profit Opportunities)
steps:
1. In View 3, click Scan for High-Priority Profit Leaks
2. Inspect network request payload and response
3. Verify whether beam search traverses dimensional hierarchy to identify buried compound culprits (Alpha, Beta, Gamma)
expected: Beam search dynamically uses available dataset dimensions to traverse combinations and identify compound culprits (e.g. Culprit Alpha: EMEA+Gold+MultiYear+EnterpriseCloud with > gap).
actual: DEFECT FOUND (DEF-UI-09): Beam search button sends hardcoded payload investigation_dims: [sales_rep, channel, contract_type] which do not exist in the 87-column schema, returning 0 findings and failing to uncover Culprits Alpha, Beta, or Gamma.
dev_comments: DEF-UI-09: In View3Triage.jsx, retrieve investigated dimensions from View 2 calibration profile or fall back to high-cardinality categorical columns from dataset schema.

scenario: 4GB RAM Ceiling & DuckDB Disk-Spilling on 15M Rows
preconditions: Monitor server process PID and memory info via psutil during 15M row execution
steps:
1. Record server RSS memory before execution
2. Execute Pass 1 preview, reconciliation, and beam search on 15M Parquet
3. Record peak RSS memory
4. Verify memory stays strictly below 4,096 MB
expected: In-process memory strictly respects the 4GB ceiling; DuckDB uses disk spilling for large operations; zero OOM crashes; UI remains responsive.
actual: Initial RSS: 55.2 MB; peak RSS during 15M preview: 230.1 MB; peak RSS during reconciliation: 254.8 MB (representing <6.3% of 4GB ceiling). DuckDB disk spilling configured; zero OOM exceptions.
dev_comments: DuckDB memory limits and columnar projection successfully prevent memory bloat on 15M-row datasets.
